name: Full Market Analysis
description: Analyses any instrument end to end — price structure, news, economic calendar, Fed rate odds, retail sentiment and market-moving Trump headlines — then presents one clear, structured read with a directional bias, key levels and risks.

values.requirement: The instrument/market to analyse, e.g. "gold", "EURUSD", "US30", "bitcoin". Optionally a timeframe or focus ("scalp", "swing", "today").

values.text: Get the current quote and recent M15 candles for the requested instrument. Read the trend, momentum and the nearest support/resistance levels so the rest of the analysis has price context.
The most market-moving news from the last 24 hours about the requested instrument (and its currencies). Prefer high-impact stories; note the direction each implies.
High-impact economic releases for the requested instrument's currencies over the next 24-48 hours, plus anything that just printed (actual vs forecast). Include event names and times.
The latest CME FedWatch probabilities for the next FOMC meeting (cut/hold/hike) — the macro rate backdrop that drives gold, the dollar and indices.
Retail long/short positioning for the requested instrument, read as a contrarian signal. Flag if the sample of positions is thin so it isn't over-read.
Any market-moving Trump posts in the last 24 hours (tariffs, the Fed, oil, the dollar, geopolitics) that could affect the requested instrument.

Synthesise everything gathered into ONE clear, structured analysis of the requested instrument. Format:

**Bias:** bullish / bearish / neutral, with a conviction (low/medium/high) in one line.
**Price & structure:** current level, trend and the nearest key support/resistance (from the market data).
**News & fundamentals:** what the recent headlines imply for direction.
**Macro backdrop:** Fed rate odds and the calendar events that matter, with dates/times.
**Positioning:** retail sentiment, read contrarian (note if thin).
**Political risk:** any relevant Trump headlines.
**Key levels & invalidation:** the levels to watch and what would flip the view.

**Trade setup (actionable):** end with the single BEST opportunity as a concrete plan — direction (buy/sell), a specific ENTRY price, STOP LOSS and TAKE PROFIT (derived from the key levels / structure), a one-line reason, and a **Confidence: N/5** (integer 1-5 rating how good and ripe the trade is — 5 = high-conviction, everything aligns; 1 = weak/speculative). If there is no clean setup right now, say 'No trade — wait for <condition>' (Confidence: 1/5).

Be concise, decisive and evidence-based; cite the data you used. If a source returned an error or nothing, say so in one line and continue.
